headline: Leeds 2-0 Newcastle: Miley own goal, then Calvert-Lewin, still live
whyCareReason: Two goals in two minutes at Elland Road. The table after Sunday is not the table yet. The match is not finished.
teaser: LIVE 36': Leeds 2-0 Newcastle. Lewis Miley own goal 32'. Dominic Calvert-Lewin header 34', James Justin the assist.
story:
Why this one matters: both clubs arrived on five points from three games. The rest of matchweek 4 was already in the book. Elland Road was the last fixture, and it has a live score.

ESPN at 36 minutes: Leeds 2-0. Lewis Miley's own goal at 32', a deflection after Ao Tanaka struck from the left. Dominic Calvert-Lewin headed in at 34' from James Justin's cross. Nico Gonzalez went off in the 19th minute as a concussion substitute for Sean Steur. That is the score. That is not a result.

Print 2-0 and 36 minutes. Do not print full time. The table after Sunday still has both clubs on three games until this one ends.
stakes: Five points each when it started. A live chance to jump the mid-table pile. Not decided.
rivalryAngle: Two unbeaten league starts, one Monday night, two goals that have not closed the night.
